CharacterVotes.title: CharacterVotes
CharacterVotes.description: Stores the accumulated vote count for a specific fictional chatbot character.

characterId.description: Unique identifier matching the character ID in characters.ts.

votes.description: Total number of votes accumulated for this character.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this vote record was last updated.

ArtGalleryLikes.title: ArtGalleryLikes
ArtGalleryLikes.description: Stores the accumulated likes count for a specific artwork.

artworkId.description: Unique identifier matching the artwork ID.

likes.description: Total number of likes accumulated for this artwork.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this like record was last updated.

SubmittedArtwork.title: SubmittedArtwork
SubmittedArtwork.description: User-submitted artwork for auto-publishing in the Art Gallery.

imageUrl.description: Direct URL link to the image file.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the artwork was submitted.

votes/{characterId}.description: Collection where each document represents the voting stats for a single character.

art_likes/{artworkId}.description: Collection where each document represents the like stats for a single artwork.

artworks/{artworkId}.description: Collection where each document represents a user-submitted artwork in the gallery.
